text: Ratel Lumina 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端的界面动效插件。它通过 DSH 客户端的 UI slots 注册设置页，并在浏览器中为输入框、会话列表、工具执行和页面过渡安装 CSS 与 Canvas 效果。用户可以调整品牌配色、动效强度、性能档位和各项效果开关；发送文字时可选择光流、液滴、溶解或幽影转场，新会话输入框也可显示流动丝带。插件支持会话活动光团、工具图标反馈、字符波浪与面板菜单动效，并遵循系统减少动态偏好。适合希望自定义 DSH 网页界面反馈和视觉节奏的用户。设置保存在浏览器本地，不需要额外 API Key 或外部服务。

Ratel Lumina adds customizable motion to DSH web clients using UI slots, CSS and Canvas. Effects include send transitions, composer ribbons, session and tool feedback, and panel motion. Users can tune colors, intensity and performance or switch effects off. It follows reduced-motion

Ratel Lumina 的功能「发送转场」：发送消息时可选光流、液滴、溶解或幽影效果，将输入文字呈现为进入对话的视觉过渡；设置为关闭时使用原有反馈。
Ratel Lumina 的功能「工具执行反馈」：当支持的工具处于准备或运行状态时，在工具图标附近显示柔和流动光效；状态完成后收束并清理效果。
Ratel Lumina 的功能「新会话丝带」：在新会话输入框获得焦点且满足场景条件时，在 composer 周围绘制流动丝带；失焦、隐藏窗口或系统减少动态时会停止绘制。
Ratel Lumina 的功能「会话活动光效」：为侧栏中运行中的会话绘制云状光团和流动星河，同时保留原生运行状态指示；浏览器或系统减少动态时按实现隐藏效果。

**Make development more fun.**

Ratel Lumina is a visual and motion enhancement plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), available on desktop and Web / PWA clients. From navigation and running sessions to typing and sending, it adds a subtle layer of motion to everyday development.
@ratel-works/dsh-lumina README · Why Lumina：Lumina does not change models, requests or message content, delay submission, or block typing, clicking and selection.

@ratel-works/dsh-lumina README · Install and update：Install DeepSeek Harness first, then search for **`ratel-dsh-lumina`** (author golddream-y) in the plugin store.

You can also install from the command line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @ratel-works/dsh-lumina
```

Replace `<profile>` with the profile you use: typically `desktop` for the desktop client or `web` for Web / PWA.

**After updating the plugin, fully quit and reopen the client** to load the new code. To update from the command line, run the installation command again.
@ratel-works/dsh-lumina README · Settings：Open **Lumina / 流光** in DSH settings. Saved changes apply immediately, without restarting.
